Ange is a minor supporting and recurring character in TABA and RPGX.

Also known as Angers, she is a weapon of the UFS, an experimental Cyborg, based on the Taimanin data of Saya NEO, Kiryu Mikoto was involved in her creation. She is an innocent woman often followed by a fan club, the A·B·G.

Don't stare at me so closely... It's a bit embarrassing after all..."
Ange


Personality
Ange is often introduced as at first emotionally cold, wishing only to test her abilities in combat. After her capture or confrontation with other people, she starts to value her life more, and she softens up and, shows more emotion.

She often follows bizarre logic, which can result in misunderstandings, as she has a poor understanding of how normal people think or act. Ange doesn't like to explain that she is a cyborg, but isn't particularly bothered about it either. Angers has opened up more and more since her capture/befriending by Fuuma Kotaro in TABA or in her time interacting with the Independent Rangers in RPGX. She is often very helpful and tries to assist in rather innocent ways, such as making additional money for her group by working part-time, which probably does very little but is still appreciated by others. Ange is worried about her short size, even if it is only the result of her modification.

Still mostly shy, she wants to impress Fuuma and can be very eager to please, but if that fails she becomes sulky. Overall, she has made many friends, although she gets often teased because of her naïveness. Angers is an innocent but timid girl, and in social situations she tends to blend with the background, often overpowered by other people around her. However, she gets jealous easily and is secretly needy, even if she does not show it.

She is fully unaware, that her rather cute demeanor, has created a large fan club, which tries to help her with her love life and "ships" Ange and Kotaro hard. Kiryu Mikoto is highly interested in Ange.


Appearance
Angers has green short hair and red eyes. Her back shows black lines, that can open and close for her tentacles to exit. She has 8 mechanical tentacles in total.

History
Background
Ange is a genetically engineered human, that was modified and turned into a cyborg, based on UFS data of Saya NEO.

Originally a UFS woman, she was boosted, and spend multiple years in important facilities of the UFS government. Ange, blends the lines of artificial demon, human and cyborg and is considered a very experimental weapon, which was trained in combat. Her creator or at lest a person involved in her creation was Kiryu Mikoto, and she was used in missions against both Demons and Taimanins. She grew up surrounded only by adults in the UFS, who would only send her into battle, which led her to become very cold and indifferent. Her experiences eventually led her to suppress her own emotions and made her shy. Ange is often treated like a child because of her small size, but this is only a result of her modification making further growth impossible, and she is an adult woman.

Typically, Ange, one way or another, will become more human, as she meets new people and overcomes her shyness.

Timeline TABA
Angers 2
The Fuuma Organization made a deal with the dark doctor, Kiryu Mikoto, the sister of Kiryu Sabato and researcher of boosted humans and demons. In exchange for the capture of Ange, she would join the Fuuma Organization. However, lead Kotaro into a fight between the UFS and Taimanin. The UFS attacking Gosha with Ange as part of a weapon test. Ange was fighting Murasaki, Sakura and Asagi. While the Taimanin were in serious danger, Mikoto's true goal was Kotaro's Evil Eye, and she wished to betray him during the confusion. While Kotaro talked with Mikoto, she tried to charm him, but this failed, as Kotaro revealed he knew of her double-crossing, which triggered her to sent out a number of lesser boosted humans prototypes of Ange. Specially, Kotaro voiced her personal connection to the disappearance of a Philosopher's Stone and Saya NEO research in Amidahara and destruction of a UFS base.

Using the chaos Fuuma Kotaro acted as a decoy while Fuuma Tokiko attacked from behind the main battle, which assisted the Taimanin. In the end, Mikoto tried to attack but was knocked out. Meanwhile, Ange was still fighting against Murasaki and Sakura, but as the UFS military was forced back Ange would later be captured by the Fuuma Organization, which used Ange's allies as a trap. Asagi arrived as well but allowed Kotaro to escape for his assistance, even if it wasn't intentional. He would afterward leaven and discipline both Ange and Mikoto forcing them into his group. Since then, Angers has made friends with people in the Fuuma Organization and has opened up a lot, to the point that she now even has a fan club.

She was eventually given a steward position next to Fuuma Tokiko. When Tokiko was captured, she tried to wake him up in the morning, but was way too shy and gets almost ignored. In general, Murasaki (ZERO) does most of her job too much of her frustration. As her fan club tried to help, she was given a bunny costume and was put into a dream world with Fuuma Kotaro (TABA), with Murasaki forced to get both out of there before things could get any weirder. The experience still gives her some courage to talk about her worry.

In a later event, Angers, tries to make extra money for Fuuma Kotaro, while taking a vacation and working part-time at a food stand. She is later needed to make Lilith Abel Bindernagel, cry, using very spicy food. Tears that were needed to defeat Fürst and was praised for it.

Timeline RPGX
Angers Bride 2
Ange is not captured by Kotaro, but interacts with his Independent Rangers.

The UFS that takes care of her does not send her out to fight the Taimanin. She appears in multiple events, and fan clubs once more form around her. In year 2083, Ange was sent out as a UFS ambassador to Gosha. The A-B-G followed her, which had members even in Gosha Village.

The A·B·G, freed Juno the goddess of love in June, which had be imprisoned as she had turned rather annoyed and sadistic towards humans. Not knowing this, the ABG hoped, Juno could help them to marry Ange, which stated she was already with Kotaro to be left alone. As Juno broke out, she used her magic to force Ange into a wedding dress and cause other chaos among Kotaro's friends. In the end, Ange helped Kotaro to stop Juno for now, until she would return next June. Angers returned again, in an Koukawa Asuka event, in which Asuka looked for a birthday present for the Masked Taimanin. Ange here is confirmed to be part of the DSO, other cyborgs like Yamada Taro and the cyborg hunter, Senjuin Benkei also appeared during that time.

In the year 2084, Juno appeared again but was almost captured by Dr. Cyclops, Ange herself found herself yet in a different wedding dress during that time. The next year, 2085, Juno's task was seemingly taken by Empusa and Ange again was involved, forced into a wedding dress yet again. Ange later on again started some part-time work during an event which ended with a fight against one of the three Naga chiefs, Takshaka.

During the civil war, in Tokyo Kingdom, assisted to break one of the barrier server points, of Anubis. She worked with Wemour, and one of the seven Kagari plant clones.

Mechanical Body: High speed, strength and endurance.
Demonic and Taimanin powers

Trivia
Her fan club has 13 members which include humans, Taimanins and orcs of the Fuuma Organization. While in RPGX, they formed an even larger group called the A·B·G.
She is sometimes also called Ange or Angers, with little consistently in TABA.
Her height is mentioned in the Taimanin Asagi Battle Arena Artbook 2.
